question: Why does the Transformer split attention into several heads instead of using a single attention function?

key_points.text: Multiple heads let the model attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

evidence.quote: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

reference_answer: Because a single attention head averages over positions and subspaces; several heads in parallel let the model jointly attend to different representation subspaces at different positions.
